create_calendar_event: create a calendar event with title, start and end datetime, location, and attendees
edit_calendar_event: edit an existing calendar event by updating its title, datetime, location, or attendees
delete_calendar_event: delete a calendar event from the calendar by its event ID
get_calendar_events: get calendar events within a specified time range with optional tag filtering
search_calendar_events: search calendar events by query string matching title, description, location, or attendees
